title: Approvals required.
bodyText: Any documents associated with the transfer of a Maui regional facility or facilities under this part shall be subject to review by the attorney general and the director of finance in their capacity to advise the governor.
bodyHtml: [§323F-53]  Approvals required.  Any documents associated with the transfer of a Maui regional facility or facilities under this part shall be subject to review by the attorney general and the director of finance in their capacity to advise the governor. [L 2015, c 103, pt of §2]
